spans.s:
नौ 1. नौ, the alternative form for the
acc., dat., and gen. of the 1st pers. pron., see अस्मद्.
नौ is an enclitic in the Veda.

नौ 2. नौ, नौस्, f. (fr. rt. 4. नु), Ved.
speech; [cf. नविष्टि.]

नौ 3. नौ, नौस्, f. (probably fr. rt. स्नु,
but said to be fr. rt. 1. नुद्; in Ṛg-veda 1. 97, 8,
नावया is Vedic inst. for नावा), a ship, a boat, a
vessel; (in astrology) N. of a peculiar appearance on
the moon; N. of a constellation; [cf. Gr. ναῦς,
ναύ-τη-ς, ναυ-τίλο-ς, ναυ-τίλλο-μαι, ναῦ-λο-ν,
ναῦ-σθ-λο-ν, ναυ-τία, ναυ-σία, ναυ-τιά-ω, ναυ-σιά-ω;
Lat. nāvis, nau-ta, nāvita, nāv-igare, nav-ig-
iu-m; Old Germ. nacho; Angl. Sax. naca; Bavarian
naue, ‘a ship;’ Old Iceland. nau-st, ‘a ship station,’
Nōa-tūn; Hib. naoi, noi.]
—नाव्-आकार, अस्, आ,
अम्, boat-shaped, cymbiform.
—नाव्-आरोह, अस्, m. a
passenger on board ship, a sailor.
—नौ-कर्णधार,
अस्, m. the steersman of a ship, a helmsman, pilot.
—नौ-कर्णी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs
attending on Skanda.
—नौ-कर्मन्, अ, n. ‘boat-
business,’ the occupation or business of a sailor.
—नौ-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going in a ship, a
sailor.
—नौ-जीविक, अस्, m. ‘living in ships or
boats,’ a sailor, boatman.
—नौ-तार्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘passable in a boat,’ navigable, to be traversed
in a vessel.
—नौ-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘boat-pole,’ an
oar.
—नौ-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘ship-binding,’ N.
of the highest peak of the Himālayas to which in the
great flood Manu fastened his ship.
—नौ-भू, cl. 1.
P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be a ship, to have been
made a ship.
—नौ-यान, अम्, n. going in a ship,
navigation.
—नौ-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a boat
or vessel, a passenger; freight.
—नौ-वाह, अस्, m.
‘ship-conductor,’ a steersman, pilot, captain.
—नौ-
व्यसन, अम्, n. ship-wreck, naufrage.
